description:
File: pkix-path/src/lib.rs:613-622

The doc comment on ValidatedPath.depth (line 619-622) explicitly notes:
'this counts all certificates except the trust anchor — including self-issued intermediates that RFC 5280 §4.2.1.9 excludes from the pathLenConstraint count.'

This means depth is NOT the RFC 5280 path length — it is chain.len() - 1. A caller comparing ValidatedPath.depth against their own pathLenConstraint-based business logic would get an incorrect count for chains with self-issued intermediates.

The warning is in the doc comment, but the field name 'depth' suggests it measures chain depth uniformly. A caller expecting RFC 5280 path length semantics will be misled.

Fix option: rename depth to chain_depth (or cert_count) and add a separate rfc5280_path_len() method or a separate field that computes non-self-issued intermediate count. Alternatively, since this is #[non_exhaustive], document that an addition of rfc5280_path_len is planned.
notes: Renaming ValidatedPath.depth is a breaking API change. Deferred to v0.2 with a doc note already present on the field.
title: pkix-path ValidatedPath.depth includes self-issued intermediates, differing from RFC 5280 pathLenConstraint count
